name: list_sessions
description:
List sandbox sessions in a project, optionally filtered by sandbox name. Sorted by creation time; paginated with limit (default 20, max 50) and an opaque cursor.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return in the response. Used for pagination.

name.description: Filter sessions by sandbox name. Only sessions belonging to the specified sandbox are returned.

project.description: The unique identifier or name of the project to list sessions for.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction for results by creation time.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
